function.name: browser_attach
function.description: Attach/launch the browser execution runtime. Prefer this over computer-use.

cdpUrl.description: Connect to existing Chrome CDP endpoint

function.name: browser_execute
function.description: Give a high-level intent. Runtime planner converts it to actions and executes with recovery/memory.

function.name: browser_run_plan
function.description: Execute an explicit deterministic browser plan JSON.

function.name: browser_observe
function.description: Return compact semantic browser state (roles, signals, modal:cookie|login|otp|payment, diffs). Not screenshots.

function.name: browser_diff
function.description: Return URL/title/signal/button/dialog changes since last observe (use after actions).

function.name: browser_resume
function.description: Resume the last failed plan from its failure step.

function.name: browser_status
function.description: Runtime status including memory engine and experience counts.

function.name: browser_tabs
function.description: List open browser tabs managed by the runtime.

function.name: browser_events
function.description: List recent runtime events (attach, steps, recovery, run_start/end). Useful instead of screenshots.
